name: gamenet_send_pkt07_alt_gun_dispatch
description: GameNet::SendPkt07_AltGunDispatch sends the local player's alternate-gun dispatch packet with the current stored target position.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet alternate-gun dispatch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x434130 validates loading g_GameStateOrMapTable->playerState, writing local player key, 16-bit weapon id, dispatch flags, and playerState->storedTargetPos into g_NetPkt07_AltGunDispatchBuf, then sending it reliably.
The native GameNet packet 7 smoke verifies reliable send target, packet header, local player key, signed 16-bit weapon id storage, dispatch flags, and copied stored target position.
